new_defects.title: pushInsteadOf is claimed as a proven D2 key in charter/DONE but no test case exists for it
new_defects.evidence: execution-safety.test.ts:465 covers exactly two configurations ("file:// rewrite", "plain path rewrite"); grep -rn pushInsteadOf src/ returns 0 hits and the only repository occurrence is charter/DONE/mg-s1b-git-env-hardening.md:14, which lists url.*.pushInsteadOf under proof 3 with mutant "remove one key from the list -> RED, for every key". Behaviour measured in chqa/evidence-d1-mechanism.txt: pushInsteadOf does not affect git remote get-url or ls-remote (contactRemote is not exploitable through it today) and no git push argv exists in src/, but the same checked URL is redirected on a push (push --dry-run exit 0). Not a bypass of the D1 fix: contactRemote still contacts exactly the checked URL.

new_defects.title: Refusal of a first-transport file:// or plain-path rewrite is unasserted
new_defects.evidence: The tests prove only that a second rewrite to file:// or a plain path is ignored at contact time (execution-safety.test.ts:465-501). The transport-refusal arm is asserted for ext:: only (execution-safety.test.ts:508-531). The code is correct on reading (file->"file", plain path->"path", neither in [https, ssh] -> GitRemoteTransportError at git-hardening.ts:170/209) but the refusal behaviour is unproven by test.

new_defects.title: A second insteadOf arriving from global or system config at contact time is untested
new_defects.evidence: The D1 fixture writes both rewrites into the repository's own .git/config (execution-safety.test.ts:477-483). No test writes url.*.into a global/XDG or system gitconfig and then proves contactRemote's isolation (git-hardening.ts:222-243: temp cwd outside any repository, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=<empty file>, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES). Code inspection says the isolation holds; no proof exercises it.

new_defects.title: charter/DONE carries no proof entry for the MCQA-D1 fix itself
new_defects.evidence: charter/DONE/mg-s1b-git-env-hardening.md records only F1, D2, D4, D5, D6 and the locator tests; grep -rnE 'D1' charter/ returns 0 hits. The regression happens to sit inside describe("git program keys") (execution-safety.test.ts:332-548) so proof 3's reopen re-runs it incidentally, but no proof line states the defect, the fixture or its mutant, contrary to charter rule 2 (done = every proof in DONE executed).

new_defects.title: The prescribed proof 5 reopen command fails without the app Svelte configuration
new_defects.evidence: The DONE root-level proof-5 command (node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run control-plane-app -t "token fragment cleared") cannot collect control-plane-app/src/zero-data-render.test.ts because App.svelte is parsed without the Svelte plugin, so it exits non-zero as written. Running the app's own config from inside control-plane-app (chqa/evidence-proof-5.txt) passes 2 tests and establishes the behaviour, but does not make the recorded reopen command green. Correct the contract command in a bounded follow-up; this frozen checkout is not to be edited.
